items.title: 〈光寶科法說〉800V Power Rack明年Q1出貨 2027資本支出高於197億元
items.title_en: Lite-On Technology Earnings Call: 800V Power Rack to Ship in Q1 Next Year, 2027 Capital Expenditure Exceeds NT$19.7 Billion
paras: 光寶科 (2301-TW) 今 (30) 日召開法說會，總經理邱森彬表示，800V HVDC Power Rack 已完成第一次送樣，11 月將第二次送樣，預計明年第一季開始出貨。為支應 AI 電源與機櫃級產品的成長，今年資本支出已從 180 億元上修到 197 億元；加上越南廣寧新廠的產線投資、美國德州廠營運，以及在全球擴大研發據點，明年資本支出還會再高於今年。公司預估明年 AI 營收占比可從今年的逾三成提高到四至五成。

光寶科指出，800V Power Rack 第一次送樣做產品認證，第二次送樣做系統整合認證，兩階段都通過後就會出貨。單一機櫃規格已從原本的 660kW 直接提高到 880kW，和運算機櫃大約是一比一的配置；另有客戶直接要 1.5MW。光寶科也透露，ASIC 客戶今年已導入 50V 低壓 Power Rack；NVIDIA 平台則會直接走 800V 高壓，下一代並希望 Power Rack 改採液冷。
對於市場傳出客戶機櫃遞延，光寶科表示，新產品的安規、零組件認證本來就需要時間，目前時程正在收斂，客戶沒有通知變更，公司仍然樂觀。產品認證、安規與系統驗證都照進度進行。不過光寶科也坦言，800V 屬於明年新平台、新資料中心的規格，實際放量要看客戶明年的落地進度。
新廠規畫部分，邱森彬表示，越南廣寧新廠的面積約為海防廠的四倍，約 100 多億元的產線投資是新增項目，不在今年 197 億元內，預計明年第一季開始動用，部分會延到後年。
邱森彬提到，伺服器客戶要求先把產能建好才會下單，所以公司必須先把設備與產線架好。加上高雄二期 12 月取得使用執照、美國德州麥金尼廠明年第二季營運，以及在美國等地擴大研發，明年資本支出「不會比今年少，一定是一年比一年多」。
面對市場缺工、缺人近況，光寶科說，亞洲與北美都缺人、缺設備、缺料、缺電，短期不容易解決，公司給出的 guidance 已經把這些瓶頸算進去。邱森彬認為，缺電是客戶最大的瓶頸，但 CSP 資本支出持續提高，相信客戶會想辦法解決，「唯一會影響的就是速度」。他以 BBU 為例，產品完成認證後，客戶拖了一年多才開始使用。
董事會今日決議把機構件事業分割給 100% 持股的子公司力能。邱森彬說，目的是讓團隊在人才、獎酬與決策上更有彈性，加快液冷事業發展；未來如果發展得好，也不排除申請上市。如果效果好，其他事業單位也可能比照分割，「AI 市場就是要快，慢了就沒機會」。
力能將負責 120kW 和 220kW 的 CDU，並結合光寶科入股的波蘭液冷廠 DCX 的設計與製造資源，雙方會把電源、CDU 與 Sidecar 整合成一個機櫃方案交給客戶，整合程度可做到 L5、L6。120kW CDU 已在第三季對企業客戶量產，第四季放量，明年的展望已經拿到。
光寶科今年資本支出從 180 億元上修到 197 億元。邱森彬表示，越南廣寧新廠約 100 多億元的產線投資是新增項目，不在 197 億元內，預計明年第一季開始動用。加上美國德州麥金尼廠明年第二季營運，以及在全球擴大研發據點，明年資本支出會比今年更高。
研發費用方面，光寶科目前研發費用率約 5%，目標先拉到 6%，之後還會往 7%、8% 走。邱森彬說，提高毛利的目的不是把錢放進口袋，而是投入研發形成正循環，長期毛利率目標要拉到至少 30%～35%。
其他事業方面，DC-DC 電源模組預估最快明年第三季開始貢獻營收。光電部門明年預估成長約一成，低軌衛星電源明年仍有機會翻倍以上成長。對於美國 337 調查，光寶科表示目前看起來沒有影響。
paras_en: Lite-On Technology (2301-TW) held its earnings conference today (the 30th). General Manager Chiu Sen‑bin said the 800V HVDC Power Rack has completed its first sample delivery, with a second sample to be sent in November, and shipments are expected to start in the first quarter of next year. To support growth in AI power supplies and rack‑level products, this year’s capital expenditure has been raised from NT$180 billion to NT$197 billion; together with production line investments at the new Guangning plant in Vietnam, operations at the Texas plant in the United States, and the expansion of R&D sites worldwide, next year’s capex will be higher than this year’s. The company forecasts AI revenue to rise from over 30% of sales this year to 40‑50% next year.

Lite-On explained that the first sample delivery of the 800V Power Rack is for product certification, while the second sample is for system integration certification. After both stages are passed, shipments will commence. The power rating of a single rack has been increased from the original 660 kW to 880 kW, roughly a 1:1 match with compute racks; some customers have even requested a 1.5 MW unit. Lite-On also disclosed that an ASIC customer has already adopted a 50 V low‑voltage Power Rack this year, while the NVIDIA platform will go straight to 800 V high‑voltage, and the next generation hopes to adopt liquid cooling for the Power Rack.

Regarding market rumors of delayed customer rack deployments, Lite-On said that safety and component certifications for the new product naturally take time, and the schedule is now converging. Customers have not indicated any changes, and the company remains optimistic. Product certification, safety approvals, and system verification are proceeding on schedule. However, Lite-On admitted that the 800V platform is a new specification for next‑year data centers, and actual volume will depend on customers’ rollout progress next year.

On the new plant plan, Chiu noted that the Guangning facility in Vietnam will be about four times the size of the Haiphong plant, with production line investments exceeding NT$100 billion. This is a new item not included in this year’s NT$197 billion capex and is expected to be drawn down starting in the first quarter of next year, with some spending pushed into the following year.

Chiu said server customers require the production capacity to be in place before placing orders, so the company must first build the equipment and production lines. With Kaohsiung Phase‑2 receiving its operating license in December, the McKinney plant in Texas slated to operate in Q2 next year, and expanded R&D sites in the United States and elsewhere, next year’s capital spending "won’t be less than this year – it will definitely be higher year over year."

Facing current labour, equipment, material and power shortages in Asia and North America, Lite-On said these constraints are short‑term and have already been factored into its guidance. Chiu believes power shortages are the biggest bottleneck for customers, but with CSP capex continuously rising, customers will find ways to address it, "the only impact will be on speed." He cited the BBU product as an example: after certification, the customer took more than a year before beginning use.

The board resolved today to spin off the mechanical components business to Li‑neng, a wholly‑owned subsidiary. Chiu said the aim is to give the team more flexibility in talent, compensation and decision‑making, accelerating the liquid‑cooling business; if it performs well, a public listing may be considered. If successful, other units could follow suit, "the AI market moves fast – slow and you lose the opportunity."

Li‑neng will handle the 120 kW and 220 kW CDUs, leveraging design and manufacturing resources from DCX, a Polish liquid‑cooling plant in which Lite-On holds a stake. Together they will integrate power supplies, CDUs and Sidecar into a single rack solution for customers, achieving integration levels of L5 or L6. The 120 kW CDU entered volume production for enterprise customers in Q3 and will scale up in Q4, with the outlook for next year already secured.

Lite-On’s capital expenditure this year has been revised from NT$180 billion to NT$197 billion. Chiu reiterated that the roughly NT$100 billion production line investment at the new Guangning plant in Vietnam is a new item outside the NT$197 billion figure and will start being drawn down in Q1 next year. Combined with the Texas McKinney plant’s operation in Q2 next year and the global expansion of R&D sites, next year’s capex will exceed this year’s.

Regarding R&D spending, Lite-On’s current R&D expense ratio is about 5%; the goal is to raise it to 6% first, then move toward 7%–8%. Chiu said the purpose of improving gross margin is not to pocket money but to invest in R&D to create a virtuous cycle, with a long‑term gross‑margin target of at least 30%–35%.

In other businesses, DC‑DC power‑module revenue is expected to start contributing in Q3 next year. The optoelectronics segment is projected to grow about 10% next year, and low‑earth‑orbit satellite power is expected to more than double. Regarding the U.S. Section 337 investigation, Lite-On said it currently sees no impact.

items.title: 〈光寶科法說〉Q3每股賺3.27元創新高 雲端電源助攻Q4營收溫和季增
items.title_en: Lite-On Technology Q3 EPS Hits Record High of NT$3.27; Cloud Power Drives Moderate Seasonal Revenue Growth in Q4
paras: 電源供應廠光寶科(2301-TW)今(30)日召開法說會並公布第三季財報，第三季稅後純益 74.3 億元，季增 4.4%，年增 59.9%，每股純益 3.27 元；展望第四季，光寶科表示，全公司第四季營收預估季增溫和，年增率和第三季相近。
光寶科第三季營收 574 億元，季增 8.9%，年增 27.9%；毛利率 25.9%，季減 1.3 個百分點，年增 0.9 個百分點；營業利益 86.6 億元，季增 5.5%，年增 84.8%；營益率 15.1%，季減 0.5 個百分點，年增 4.7 個百分點。稅後純益 74.3 億元，季增 4.4%，年增 59.9%，每股純益 3.27 元。
光寶科前三季累計營收 1,535.1 億元，年增 26.1%；毛利率 25.2%，年增 1.9 個百分點；營業利益 209.6 億元，年增 73.4%；營益率 13.7%，年增 3.8 個百分點；稅後純益 183.2 億元，年增 62.8%，每股純益 8.08 元。
光寶科指出，第三季毛利率 25.9%、營益率 15.1%，都優於上半年的 24.7% 與 12.8%。毛利率雖然比第二季下滑，但總經理邱森彬說明，第二季因出貨遞延，毛利率本來就偏高，第三季並沒有一次性挹注。公司建議以半年平均來看獲利表現。
展望第四季，光寶科預估雲端電源仍有季增和年增，不過 PC 與消費性產品比較辛苦，全公司第四季營收預估季增溫和，年增率和第三季相近；毛利率則維持第三季水準。
資產負債表方面，第三季存貨季增 110 億元，短期借款季增 105 億元。公司說明，這是針對 PCB、高壓電容、半導體等關鍵零組件做的策略性備料，也是因應客戶依 未來發展要求的安全庫存。
產品營收占比部分，從雲端物聯網部門營收 338 億元，年增 57%，營收占比 59%，營業利益 71 億元，年增超過一倍。光電部門營收 81 億元，年增 17%，受惠工控與新能源應用。資訊及消費性電子部門營收 155 億元，年減 6%，營業利益 16 億元，年減 3%。
光寶科總經理邱森彬表示，雲端部門部門裡同時有企業級備援電源和 AI 伺服器電源。企業級產品年增約 30% 多，AI 伺服器電源成長八成以上，兩者合計大約成長七成。光寶科也說，雲端電源在第三季已占全公司營收約 52%，全年成長超過七成的目標不變。
資訊部門受到 PC 與消費性產品拖累，市場預估下半年 PC 衰退約兩成，衰退幅度比公司原本預期的大。光寶科靠低軌衛星電源出貨年增近一倍，抵銷了部分衰退。公司透露，低軌衛星電源約占資訊部門營收 10%，光寶科是美系兩大低軌衛星客戶的主要供應商。
paras_en: Lite-On Technology (2301-TW) held its earnings conference today (30th) and released its third‑quarter financial results, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$7.43 billion, up 4.4% sequentially and 59.9% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$3.27. Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, the company said it expects a modest sequential increase in group revenue, with an annual growth rate similar to that of the third quarter.

In Q3, Lite-On posted revenue of NT$57.4 billion, up 8.9% sequentially and 27.9% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 25.9%, down 1.3 percentage points sequentially but up 0.9 points year‑over‑year. Operating profit reached NT$8.66 billion, up 5.5% sequentially and 84.8% year‑over‑year, yielding an operating margin of 15.1%, down 0.5 points sequentially and up 4.7 points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$7.43 billion, up 4.4% sequentially and 59.9% year‑over‑year, translating to earnings per share of NT$3.27.

For the first three quarters, Lite-On’s cumulative revenue was NT$153.51 billion, a 26.1% year‑over‑year increase; gross margin stood at 25.2%, up 1.9 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating profit was NT$20.96 billion, up 73.4% year‑over‑year, with an operating margin of 13.7%, up 3.8 points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax totaled NT$18.32 billion, a 62.8% year‑over‑year rise, and earnings per share were NT$8.08.

Lite-On noted that the Q3 gross margin of 25.9% and operating margin of 15.1% both exceeded the first‑half figures of 24.7% and 12.8%. Although the gross margin slipped from Q2, General Manager Chiu Sen‑bin explained that Q2 margins were unusually high due to delayed shipments, and Q3 did not receive a one‑off boost. The company recommends evaluating profitability on a six‑month average basis.

Looking ahead to Q4, Lite-On expects cloud‑power sales to continue growing both sequentially and annually, while the PC and consumer‑electronics segments face tougher conditions. Group revenue for the quarter is projected to rise modestly sequentially, with an annual growth rate similar to Q3’s, and gross margin is expected to stay at the Q3 level.

On the balance sheet, Q3 inventory rose by NT$11 billion sequentially and short‑term borrowings increased by NT$10.5 billion. The company said these reflect strategic stocking of key components such as PCBs, high‑voltage capacitors and semiconductors, as well as safety stock to meet customers’ future development requirements.

In terms of product revenue mix, the cloud‑IoT segment generated NT$33.8 billion, up 57% year‑over‑year and accounting for 59% of total revenue, with operating profit of NT$7.1 billion, more than double the prior year. The optoelectronics segment posted NT$8.1 billion in revenue, up 17% year‑over‑year, benefiting from industrial control and new‑energy applications. The information and consumer‑electronics segment recorded NT$15.5 billion in revenue, down 6% year‑over‑year, with operating profit of NT$1.6 billion, down 3% year‑over‑year.

General Manager Chiu Sen‑bin said the cloud segment includes both enterprise‑grade backup power supplies and AI server power supplies. Enterprise products grew roughly 30% year‑over‑year, while AI server power supplies surged by more than 80%, together delivering about a 70% overall increase. Lite-On also noted that cloud power accounted for roughly 52% of total company revenue in Q3, and the target of over 70% annual growth remains unchanged.

The information segment was weighed down by the PC and consumer‑electronics slowdown, with market forecasts indicating a roughly 20% decline in PC shipments in the second half, a larger drop than the company had anticipated. Lite-On offset part of the decline with low‑Earth‑orbit satellite power shipments that nearly doubled year‑over‑year. The company disclosed that low‑Earth‑orbit satellite power makes up about 10% of the information segment’s revenue, and Lite-On is a major supplier to two leading U.S. LEO satellite customers.

items.title: 外資單日重砍台股1124億元創史上第七大賣超 反手布局防禦型傳產股
items.title_en: Foreign investors slash Taiwan stocks by NT$112.4 billion in a day, marking the seventh‑largest net sell‑off ever, and turn to defensive industrial stocks
paras: 台北股市今(30)日大盤開低震盪，尾盤集中市場守住45000點大關，以45211.83點作收，較昨日下跌1156.5點，市場成交值8777.3億元。集中市場三大法人合計賣超1398.44億元，其中外資下重手賣超1124.67億元，創下史上第七大賣超紀錄，同時，外資在期貨市場並加空1780口空單。
外資今天在集中市場酌量買超的個股多屬傳產、航運及電信族群龍頭股，包括台泥(1101-TW)、中華電(2412-TW)、長榮(2603-TW)、寶成(9904-TW)、統一(1216-TW)。
今天在現貨市場中，外資賣超1124.67億元，投信買超239.93億元，自營商合計賣超513.7億元，三大法人合計賣超1398.44億元，在期貨市場，外資30日交易口數淨額爲空單1780口，未平倉口數爲空單94241口。
新台幣兌美元匯率今天以32.478元作收、升值1.4分，台北外匯市場成交金額24.4億美元。
今天集中市場外資買超較多的個股爲，陽明、台泥、臺企銀、中華電、合庫金、長榮、寶成、統一、華航、彰銀；今天集中市場外資賣超較多的個股爲，友達、力積電、國巨*、南亞、仁寶、台新新光金、宏碁、緯創、群創。
今天集中市場投信買超較多的個股爲，台新新光金、中信金、佳世達、日月光投控、玉山金、第一金、國泰金、永豐金、元大金、南亞；今天集中市場投信賣超較多的個股爲，聯電、華航、遠東新、台泥、友達、統一、昇陽半導體、致伸、長興、台達電。
今天集中市場自營商買超較多的個股爲，台新新光金、華南金、凱基金、浪凡、兆豐金、中信金、玉山金、永豐金、元大金、統一；今天集中市場自營商賣超較多的個股爲，友達、群創。
資深證券、期貨分析師張陳浩指出，台股今天以45211.83點作收，下跌1156.5點，大盤最大敗筆在於大盤跌破半年線，大盤整理的時間將拉長，主要在谷歌、英特爾等重量級美股提出的展望引發市場對科技類股現金流及投資回收的重大疑慮，同時，台股處於高檔區，在此一情境之下，也引發多殺多的格局，但並未顯示台股大幅走空。
paras_en: The Taipei stock market opened lower and traded sideways today (30th), with the main board holding above the 45,000‑point threshold, closing at 45,211.83 points, down 1,156.5 points from yesterday. Market turnover was NT$8777.3 billion. The three major institutional investors in the main board net sold NT$1398.44 billion, of which foreign investors sold a heavy NT$1124.67 billion, the seventh‑largest net sell‑off on record. At the same time, foreign investors added 1,780 short contracts in the futures market.

Today, the stocks that foreign investors modestly net bought in the main board were mainly leaders in the traditional industry, shipping and telecom sectors, including Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW), Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW), Evergreen Marine (2603‑TW), Pou Chen (9904‑TW) and Uni‑President (1216‑TW).

In the spot market today, foreign investors sold NT$1124.67 billion, investment trusts bought NT$239.93 billion, proprietary traders sold NT$513.7 billion, for a combined net sell of NT$1398.44 billion among the three major institutions. In the futures market, foreign investors had a net short position of 1,780 contracts on the 30th, with open interest of 94,241 short contracts.
The New Taiwan dollar closed at NT$32.478 per US dollar, appreciating 0.014, and the Taipei foreign‑exchange market saw a transaction volume of US$2.44 billion.

In the main board, the stocks with the largest foreign‑investor net purchases were Yang Ming, Taiwan Cement, Taichung Commercial Bank, Chunghwa Telecom, Heku Financial, Evergreen Marine, Pou Chen, Uni‑President, China Airlines, and Chang Hwa Bank. The stocks with the largest foreign‑investor net sales were AU Optronics, Powerchip, Yageo*, Nanya, Compal, Taishin Shin Kong Financial, Acer, Wistron, and Innolux.

Among investment trusts, the top net‑buy stocks in the main board were Taishin Shin Kong Financial, CTBC Financial, Qisda, ASE Technology Holding, E.SUN Financial, First Financial, Cathay Financial, Yongfeng Financial, Yuanta Financial, and Nanya. The top net‑sell stocks were United Microelectronics, China Airlines, Far Eastern New Century, Taiwan Cement, AU Optronics, Uni‑President, Sunplus Technology, ChipMOS, Chang Hsing, and Delta Electronics.

Among proprietary traders, the top net‑buy stocks in the main board were Taishin Shin Kong Financial, Hua Nan Financial, KGI Fund, Langfan, Mega Financial, CTBC Financial, E.SUN Financial, Yongfeng Financial, Yuanta Financial, and Uni‑President. The top net‑sell stocks were AU Optronics and Innolux.

Senior securities and futures analyst Zhang Chen‑hao noted that the Taiwan market closed at 45,211.83 points, down 1,156.5 points. The biggest flaw was the index falling below its six‑month moving average, which will likely lengthen the consolidation period. The outlooks from heavyweight U.S. stocks such as Google and Intel raised major concerns about cash flow and investment returns for tech stocks, and with the Taiwan market in a high‑level zone, this scenario sparked a “sell‑more‑sell‑more” pattern, though it did not indicate a sharp short‑term decline.

items.title: 〈鴻海科技日〉發表3款全新電動車參考設計 擴大B2B產品組合
items.title_en: Foxconn Technology Day Unveils Three New Electric Vehicle Reference Designs, Expanding B2B Product Portfolio
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(30)日於科技日發表3款全新參考設計電動車，分別為休旅車MODEL A+、MODEL K+及小型貨卡MODEL K，鎖定B級SUV、年輕族群及輕型商用車等市場，持續展現為汽車客戶提供委託設計製造服務(CDMS)的實力，進一步擴大B2B電動車產品組合。
此次發表的3款車型各有不同定位。其中，MODEL A+延續MODEL A的設計理念，瞄準成長快速的B級SUV市場，進一步擴大鴻海B2B產品組合。車款融合奢華風格與越野性能，搭載輪內馬達技術，並提供電子電氣架構(EEA)選配，鎖定有意切入高附加價值電動車市場的企業客戶。
MODEL K+則主打年輕族群及利基市場，以日本懷舊元素結合新世代City Pop風格，打造兼具個性與親民價格的生活風格休旅車。車款搭載輪內馬達技術，外觀、內裝、續航里程及電子電氣架構均可依客戶需求客製化，協助車廠以具競爭力的價格，開發具品牌特色的電動車。
至於MODEL K，則是鴻海切入日本K-Car輕型貨卡級距的新設計，外觀承襲大型巴士MODEL T的設計語彙，鎖定配送、行動商業及防災等商用需求。車體結構強調實用性，可搭配不同車體改裝及服務，應用於最後一哩物流、移動商鋪及行動供電站等場景，並藉由降低能源使用及維護成本，減少總持有成本(TCO)。
除了3款新車，鴻海此次也展示電動移動生態系的研發成果，涵蓋材料、電芯、電池模組、電池管理系統(BMS)，以及電子電氣架構與電動二輪車、三輪車動力系統。此外，現場也展出右駕版MODEL B，呈現鴻海與車廠合作的CDMS成果。
鴻海自6年前推出首款參考車型以來，參考設計電動車陣容已累計達12款。除此次發表的3款新車外，既有車型還包括大型巴士MODEL T、休旅車MODEL C、豪華轎車MODEL E、跨界休旅車MODEL B、貨卡MODEL V、廂型貨車MODEL N、多功能休旅車MODEL D、中型巴士MODEL U，以及模組化B級車MODEL A。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317-TW) today (30th) announced three brand‑new reference‑design electric vehicles at its Technology Day: the SUV MODEL A+, the MODEL K+, and the compact cargo van MODEL K. Targeting the B‑segment SUV market, younger consumers and light‑commercial vehicles, the launch showcases Foxconn’s capability to provide contract design‑manufacturing services (CDMS) for automotive clients and further broadens its B2B EV product lineup.

The three models each serve a distinct market niche. MODEL A+ carries forward the design philosophy of the original MODEL A and aims at the fast‑growing B‑segment SUV segment, further expanding Foxconn’s B2B offerings. The vehicle blends a luxury aesthetic with off‑road capability, features in‑wheel motor technology and offers an optional electronic‑electrical architecture (EEA), appealing to corporate customers looking to enter the high‑value‑add EV market.

MODEL K+ is aimed at younger buyers and niche markets, combining nostalgic Japanese elements with a new‑generation City‑Pop style to create a lifestyle‑oriented SUV that is both distinctive and affordable. It uses in‑wheel motors, and its exterior, interior, range and EEA can be customized to customer specifications, helping automakers develop brand‑centric EVs at competitive prices.

MODEL K represents Foxconn’s entry into Japan’s K‑Car light‑cargo‑van segment, borrowing the design language of the large‑bus MODEL T. It targets delivery, mobile business and disaster‑relief applications. The vehicle’s structure emphasizes practicality and can be fitted with various body‑work modifications and services for last‑mile logistics, mobile shops and mobile power‑station scenarios, reducing energy use, maintenance expenses and overall total cost of ownership (TCO).

In addition to the three new models, Foxconn also displayed its electric‑mobility ecosystem R&D results, covering materials, cells, battery modules, battery‑management systems (BMS), as well as electronic‑electrical architectures and power‑train systems for electric two‑ and three‑wheelers. A right‑hand‑drive version of MODEL B was also shown, illustrating Foxconn’s CDMS collaborations with vehicle manufacturers.

Since launching its first reference model six years ago, Foxconn’s portfolio of reference‑design EVs has grown to twelve models. Beyond the three newly announced vehicles, the existing lineup includes the large bus MODEL T, SUV MODEL C, luxury sedan MODEL E, crossover SUV MODEL B, cargo van MODEL V, box truck MODEL N, multi‑purpose SUV MODEL D, mid‑size bus MODEL U, and the modular B‑segment vehicle MODEL A.

items.title: 波羅的海運價指數 是怎麼被南韓船王「畫」出來的？
items.title_en: How South Korea's Shipping Tycoon "Painted" the Baltic Freight Index
paras: 一樁轟動全球能源界的航運訴訟，近日在英國高等法院揭開序幕。大宗商品貿易巨頭摩科瑞(Mercuria)將擁有282年歷史的波羅的海交易所(Baltic Exchange)告上法庭，指控其核心的「TD3C」超大型原油輪(VLCC)運價指數在中東地緣衝突爆發後徹底失真，導致衍生性金融商品市場陷入巨大混亂與虧損，要求法院追溯性暫停該指數發布，並已向英國金融行為監管局(FCA)提出正式申訴。
這場訴訟不僅揭露了數億美元的避險危機，更將一家低調而龐大的南韓航運巨頭——長錦商船(Sinokor)，推到了全球焦點中心。

戰火下的「定價真空」

這場運價風暴的源頭，來自中東爆發的伊朗戰爭。受戰火影響，戰略咽喉荷姆茲海峽的商業運輸幾近停擺，西方主流船東因忌憚飛彈襲擊與高昂的戰時額外保費而紛紛撤離。
然而，由前南韓船東協會會長鄭泰順之子鄭嘉鉉控制、起源於香港離岸破局經驗的長錦商船(Sinokor Group)，卻逆向而行。
早在戰火爆發前，長錦商船便在瑞士地中海航運(MSC)的資金支持下，於二手船市場展開大規模收購，將逾80艘至93艘VLCC納入麾下。當外商船隊退縮時，手握龐大實體船隊的長錦商船選擇留在波斯灣，並於2026年9月包攬了穿越荷姆茲海峽約37%的原油運量(總運輸量約2.863億桶)，一舉成為市場上最大的現貨掌控者與實體壟斷者。
在實體貿易轉入「暗夜擺渡」(油輪關閉AIS衛星應答器、夜間短途穿梭並進行船對船轉運)的背景下，公開成交數據幾近枯竭。
長錦商船順勢建立了一套獨特的場外資訊傳播機制：其管理層建立了拉入大量船舶經紀商與內部員工的龐大WhatsApp通訊軟體群組。長錦商船定期在群組中群發(blasts)租船訊息，宣稱旗下油輪以刷新紀錄的天價(如日租金突破140萬美元，Worldscale指數從約400點狂飆至1350點)成功租出。
然而，這些群發訊息多半缺乏底層合約細節(例如是否包含船東自擔的保險費或明確目的地)，甚至衛星影像顯示，長錦商船宣稱8月初租往亞洲的油輪，直到10月仍停留在波斯灣與印度洋水域。但在資訊真空環境下，這些單方面宣告成為了市場唯一的定價依據。

世紀機制的制度失靈

為何航運巨頭在通訊軟體上記述的幾行文字，能直接撼動倫敦交易所大盤？根源在於波羅的海交易所延續百年的「專家評估制」。
TD3C指數衡量從波斯灣至中國的VLCC運費，每日下午4點由9家指定船舶經紀商提交主觀估值後取平均值發布。和平時期，該機制仰賴透明成交與衛星定位運作；但在戰爭衝擊下，當經紀商連續數日看不到透明交易時，只能被迫參照長錦商船在WhatsApp群組散布的高價訊息。
當部分經紀商嘗試改用沙特阿拉伯在紅海側運作正常的港口數據評估時，卻遭到波羅的海交易所干預，堅持評估必須反映波斯灣內部裝貨成本，進一步將經紀商逼入絕境。
在130個交易日中，有多達12次出現經紀商因無法核實真實運價而拒絕報價，甚至有機構在9月宣布無限期暫停提交數據。
對此，Zostera Marine 執行長兼愛爾蘭國立海事學院教授 Joel Grau 指出：「長錦商船對市場動態以及超大型原油輪(VLCC)市場的基本面，發揮著舉足輕重的巨大影響力。」
波羅的海交易所 TD3C 評估員 Christopher Loveday 在內部郵件中私下表達憂慮。他詢問交易所是否已針對這種有疑慮的市场狀況尋求法律諮詢，並警告若缺乏透明度的局勢持續，波羅的海交易所恐將面臨類似十多年前「倫敦銀行間拆款利率(Libor)操縱案」的嚴峻考驗與合規危機。

貿易巨頭與交易所的法律交鋒

當被單一寡頭「描繪」出來的現貨指數傳導至金融衍生性商品市場時，避險機制隨之失靈。大宗商品貿易商在金融市場賣出掛鉤TD3C的遠期運費協議(FFA)進行避險，然而戰時多數貿易商已轉至海峽外的安全港口接貨，其承擔的實體成本是海峽外運費，金融空頭頭寸卻被迫按照長錦商船主導的TD3C指數高價結算，面臨嚴重的逼空危機。
針對這場金融與法律風暴，摩科瑞能源集團(Mercuria Energy Group)在其起訴書與監管申訴中主張，由於荷姆茲海峽運輸幾近停擺，TD3C指數已完全失去計算基礎與基準功能，導致其避險頭寸蒙受數億美元巨額損失。摩科瑞強調，其訴訟訴求是要求法院立即追溯性暫停該指數，而非試圖從交易所獲取金錢賠償。
波羅的海交易所及其母公司新加坡交易所(SGX)辯護律師在法庭上表示，繼續發布TD3C指數並非輕率決定。若依原告要求追溯性廢止過去八個多月的指數，在司法管轄歷史上完全缺乏先例，且將引發全球數百筆已結算航運合約與數億美元衍生性商品清算體系的連環癱瘓與市場災難。
英國金融行為監管局(FCA)發言人強調，監管機構無法針對與個別企業的交涉細節發表評論，但自美伊衝突爆發以來，監管部門一直持續監控該事件對市場及指數基準的影響。
paras_en: A high‑profile shipping lawsuit that has rocked the global energy sector opened recently in the UK High Court. Commodity‑trading giant Mercuria has sued the 282‑year‑old Baltic Exchange, alleging that its core "TD3C" ultra‑large crude carrier (VLCC) freight index became completely distorted after the outbreak of Middle‑East geopolitical conflict, throwing derivative markets into chaos and losses, and is seeking a retroactive suspension of the index while filing a formal complaint with the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).
The case not only exposed a hedging crisis worth hundreds of millions of dollars, but also thrust a low‑profile yet massive South Korean shipping giant—Sinokor—into the global spotlight.

The "pricing vacuum" under fire The freight storm originated from the Iran war in the Middle East. The conflict crippled commercial traffic through the strategic Strait of Hormuz, prompting mainstream Western shipowners to withdraw over missile‑risk fears and soaring wartime surcharges.

However, Sinokor Group, controlled by the son of former Korean Shipowners’ Association chairman Jung Tae‑soon, Jung Ka‑hyun, and born out of a Hong‑Kong offshore break‑up experience, moved in the opposite direction.

Even before the fighting began, Sinokor, backed by financing from Swiss Mediterranean Shipping Company (MSC), launched a large‑scale purchase programme in the second‑hand market, acquiring between 80 and 93 VLCCs. When foreign fleets retreated, Sinokor kept its massive physical fleet in the Persian Gulf and, by September 2026, secured roughly 37% of the oil volume transiting the Strait of Hormuz (about 286.3 million barrels), becoming the largest spot‑market holder and physical monopolist.
Against a backdrop of "night‑time ferrying"—tankers turning off AIS, making short night hops and conducting ship‑to‑ship transfers—public transaction data all but vanished.

Sinokor seized the moment to build a unique over‑the‑counter information network: its management created a huge WhatsApp group that pulls in dozens of ship brokers and internal staff. The company regularly blasts charter offers in the group, claiming its tankers are being hired at record‑breaking rates (e.g., day rates exceeding $1.4 million and Worldscale points soaring from around 400 to 1,350).

These broadcast messages often lack underlying contract details (such as whether the charterer bears insurance costs or the exact destination), and satellite imagery even showed a vessel Sinokor said was chartered to Asia in early August still lingering in the Persian Gulf and Indian Ocean in October. Yet in the information vacuum, these unilateral announcements became the market’s sole pricing reference.
Why a few lines of chat can move the London market The root lies in the Baltic Exchange’s century‑old "expert assessment" system.

The TD3C index measures VLCC freight from the Persian Gulf to China; each afternoon at 4 p.m. nine designated ship brokers submit subjective valuations, which are then averaged and published. In peacetime the system relies on transparent trades and satellite tracking, but under war conditions, when brokers cannot see transparent deals for days, they are forced to rely on the high‑price information Sinokor circulates in its WhatsApp group.

When some brokers tried to use normal port data from Saudi Arabia on the Red Sea side for their assessments, the Baltic Exchange intervened, insisting that valuations must reflect internal loading costs in the Persian Gulf, further squeezing the brokers.

During the 130‑day trading period, brokers refused to quote up to 12 times because they could not verify real freight rates, and an institution announced in September that it would indefinitely suspend data submissions.
Zostera Marine CEO and professor at the Irish National Maritime College Joel Grau said, "Sinokor exerts a decisive influence on market dynamics and the fundamentals of the VLCC market."

Baltic Exchange TD3C assessor Christopher Loveday privately expressed concern in an internal email, asking whether the exchange had sought legal advice on the dubious market conditions and warning that a prolonged lack of transparency could expose the exchange to a compliance crisis comparable to the Libor manipulation scandal a decade ago.

Legal clash between the trader and the exchange When a spot index painted by a single oligarch feeds into financial derivatives, hedging mechanisms break down. Commodity traders sell forward freight agreements (FFAs) linked to the TD3C to hedge, but during wartime most traders shift to safe‑port pickups outside the strait, incurring actual out‑of‑strait freight costs while their financial short positions are forced to settle at the inflated TD3C rates dictated by Sinokor, creating a severe short‑squeeze.

In its complaint and regulatory filing, Mercuria Energy Group argues that because transport through the Strait of Hormuz has nearly halted, the TD3C index has lost any calculable basis or benchmark function, causing hedgers to suffer losses of hundreds of millions of dollars. Mercuria stresses that its remedy is an immediate retroactive suspension of the index, not monetary compensation from the exchange.

The Baltic Exchange and its parent Singapore Exchange (SGX) counsel told the court that continuing to publish the TD3C is not a reckless decision. Retroactively cancelling more than eight months of index data would have no precedent in judicial history and would trigger a cascade of failures across hundreds of settled shipping contracts and billions of dollars of derivative clearings worldwide.

A spokesperson for the UK FCA said the regulator cannot comment on the specifics of individual company negotiations, but has been continuously monitoring the impact of the US‑Iran conflict on the market and the index’s benchmark since the hostilities began.

items.title: 台股震盪整理 考驗主動式ETF策略
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Consolidates, Testing Active ETF Strategies
paras: 台股近期遭遇明顯修正，外資調節、科技股震盪與市場避險情緒升溫，使投資人對第四季行情轉趨謹慎。然而，股價下跌不代表基本面同步轉弱。台灣外銷訂單持續成長，製造業用電警戒燈號連續18個月亮紅燈，反映產業活動仍具一定動能；政府基金釋出1,550億元代操資金，也為後續市場資金動向增添觀察重點。短線行情或許風雨飄搖，但投資判斷仍須回到企業獲利與估值，而非單看指數漲跌。

面對震盪，除了觀察技術面，更應檢視個股籌碼。台股融資餘額仍在6,400多億元的高檔，卻不能單憑融資水位就認定市場即將出現全面性斷頭。真正需要警戒的是融資使用率偏高、融資維持率偏低的個股，一旦股價持續下跌，容易引發追繳與被迫賣出；反之，若企業獲利仍有成長動能，且融資維持率相對穩健，行情回穩時也可能出現反彈機會。對偏好穩健的投資人而言，瑞昱、達發、健策及華新科等個股，可進一步從估值、獲利與籌碼結構重新檢視。市場恐慌時，關鍵不是急著抄底，而是辨識風險與機會。
接下來，聯準會利率決策與美國科技巨頭財報，將是影響市場信心的重要變數。Google、微軟、亞馬遜等企業的資本支出展望，將牽動全球AI供應鏈的投資預期。從產業趨勢來看，AI算力建置仍是中長期主軸，記憶體受惠供需變化與長約需求，ABF載板、PCB、玻纖布及銅箔基板則有產品升級、供給緊張與價格調整等題材；電力、散熱、先進封裝及半導體設備，也持續受惠資料中心與AI基礎建設的擴張。
不過，產業成長不代表股價只漲不跌。當資金集中追逐特定題材，估值偏高、持股過度擁擠的族群，仍可能在市場風險偏好下降時遭到集中調節。聯發科AI ASIC業務雖有部分專案時程調整的雜音，長期成長潛力仍值得觀察；記憶體與高階載板也須持續追蹤供需、訂單及價格變化。第四季較可能呈現多個產業輪動，而非單一族群全面領漲。投資人除了看成長故事，更應確認獲利能否兌現，並衡量股價是否已提前反映未來利多。

在市場震盪、個股表現分歧的環境下，主動式ETF的績效差異，也反映不同投資組合在修正期間的承受能力。以6月24日至10月27日為比較區間，其中規模高達2800多億的主動統一台股增長 (00981A)為 - 11.02%，主動統一升級(00403A)則為 -10.69%，主動中信台灣收益(00406A)為 -9.66%，而主動凱基台灣(00407A)報酬率則為 -7.09%。就這四檔產品的統計結果而言，00407A跌幅相對較小，期間表現優於其餘三檔比較標的。
主動式ETF的績效，會受到經理人選股、持股權重、產業配置與進出場時點影響；市場風格改變時，原本有利的配置也可能轉為壓力。投資人評估產品時，除了比較階段報酬，也應留意最大回檔、波動程度、持股集中度、費用及操作策略。尤其在市場快速修正時，短期跌幅較小固然值得注意，但是否能在不同行情中持續維持風險與報酬的平衡，仍需要更長期間的績效資料驗證。
除了選股與持股配置，配息政策也是評估ETF時不可忽略的一環。由於00407A採取不配息策略，與定期配息型ETF的資金運用方式不同。配息型產品能提供投資人可運用的現金流，但配息並不等於額外創造報酬；不配息產品則不透過現金配發將收益交到投資人手中，投資人更應關注基金淨值變化及整體資產累積效果。兩種策略各有適用情境，不能僅憑配息與否判斷優劣。
2025年4月川普關稅戰，大盤重挫27%，我卻在危機中大賺65%；2026年3月美伊戰爭，大盤下跌11%，我大賺72%；還有AI泡沫疑慮、近期市場震盪，每一次恐慌過後，就是我表演的時候！
我始終強調，不必執著猜最低點，而是要有紀律地分批布局、汰弱留強。

Short‑term moves may be turbulent, but investment judgments should return to corporate earnings and valuations rather than merely index swings.

In the face of volatility, beyond technical analysis one should examine individual stock fundamentals. Taiwan’s margin financing balance remains high at over NT$640 billion, yet a high financing level alone does not signal an imminent market-wide crash. The real warning lies with stocks that have a high financing usage rate and low maintenance margin; if their prices keep falling, margin calls and forced sales can erupt. Conversely, if a company’s earnings still have growth momentum and its maintenance margin remains solid, a rebound may emerge when the market steadies. For investors who favor stability, stocks such as Realtek, Dafa, Jencet and Huaxin Technology can be re‑evaluated on valuation, profitability and capital structure. In times of market panic, the key is not to rush to bottom‑fish but to identify risk and opportunity.

Looking ahead, the Federal Reserve’s rate decisions and earnings reports from U.S. tech giants will be pivotal for market confidence. Outlooks for capital expenditures from Google, Microsoft, Amazon and others will shape global AI supply‑chain investment expectations. From an industry perspective, AI compute power remains a mid‑to‑long‑term focus; memory chips benefit from supply‑demand shifts and long‑term contracts, while ABF substrates, PCBs, glass‑fiber cloth and copper‑foil substrates see themes of product upgrades, tight supply and price adjustments. Power, cooling, advanced packaging and semiconductor equipment also continue to profit from data‑center and AI infrastructure expansion.

Nevertheless, industry growth does not guarantee that stock prices only rise. When capital chases specific themes, over‑valued and overly crowded stocks can be sharply corrected as risk appetite wanes. MediaTek’s AI ASIC business, despite some project‑timeline noise, still holds long‑term growth potential; memory and high‑end substrates also require ongoing monitoring of supply‑demand, orders and price changes. The fourth quarter is likely to feature multiple sector rotations rather than a single group leading the rally. Investors should not only follow growth narratives but also verify whether earnings can be realized and assess whether prices have already priced in future upside.

In a volatile market with divergent stock performances, the differing returns of active ETFs also reflect how various portfolios weather corrections. Over the period from June 24 to October 27, the large‑cap active Unified Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A) posted a –11.02% return, the active Unified Upgrade ETF (00403A) –10.69%, the active CTBC Taiwan Yield ETF (00406A) –9.66%, while the active KGI Taiwan ETF (00407A) returned –7.09%. Active‑ETF performance is shaped by the manager’s stock‑picking, weightings, sector allocation and timing of trades; when market styles shift, a previously advantageous allocation can become a liability. When evaluating a product, investors should look beyond period returns to maximum drawdown, volatility, concentration, fees and the underlying strategy. Especially in rapid corrections, a modest short‑term drop is noteworthy, but whether the fund can sustain a risk‑return balance across different market regimes requires longer‑term performance evidence.

Beyond stock selection and weighting, dividend policy is another essential factor in ETF assessment. Because 00407A follows a non‑dividend approach, its cash‑flow dynamics differ from regularly distributing ETFs. Dividend‑paying products provide investors with usable cash flow, yet dividends do not create extra return; non‑dividend funds retain earnings within the fund, so investors should focus on NAV changes and overall asset accumulation. paras: 一、盤勢結構：利空衝擊加劇，指數重挫逾千點

台股今日呈現「開低震盪走低」格局，終場大跌 1,156點，收在45,211點，成交值約8,777億元，盤中最低下探44,726點，跌幅一度超過1,600點，顯示市場避險情緒明顯升高。
主要受到美國科技股重挫、AI資本支出效益疑慮升溫影響，加上Alphabet財報不如預期、Marvell股價大跌，市場重新檢視AI投資回收期與企業獲利能力，導致AI供應鏈及電子權值股遭遇沉重賣壓。
此外，中東地緣政治風險與能源價格的不確定性仍在，進一步壓抑投資人追價意願。短線而言，市場信心尚未恢復，利空反覆測試底部的震盪整理，仍是合理的發展。


二、技術面：重要均線失守，44,200點附近成為觀察重點

指數已跌破10日線、月線及季線，短期均線呈現下彎壓力，技術結構明顯轉弱，短線仍須提防賣壓持續釋放。
盤中一度跌破半年線，但終場重新站回45,000點及半年線附近，代表下檔仍有部分承接力量。
下檔先觀察8月25日止跌區約44,210點附近，以及7月31日止跌長紅K棒約41,610～43,214點區間。若能逐步止穩，才有機會形成新的築底結構。
後續須觀察成交量是否降溫、指數能否重新站回10日線及月線，作為市場信心與反彈力道恢復的重要依據。


三、基本面：AI長線需求未變，台灣經濟仍具成長動能

台股短線受到國際科技股修正拖累，但台灣出口與AI產業基本面仍然強勁。經濟部公布9月外銷訂單達 1,142.1億美元，年增62.4％，連續兩個月突破千億美元，前9月累計8,192億美元，已提前超越去年全年紀錄。
經濟成長方面，央行最新預估2026年GDP成長率達11.48％，主計總處預估11.05％，顯示台灣經濟成長動能仍相當強勁。
AI並非需求消失，而是市場開始要求企業證明資本支出的獲利回收能力。Alphabet第三季雲端營收年增103％，但自由現金流轉負，正反映AI產業從高速擴張進入獲利驗證階段。
因此，短線評價修正不等於產業趨勢反轉，後續應更加重視訂單能見度、毛利率、現金流及實際獲利成長。


四、產業布局：掌握AI五大核心主軸與低基期復甦族群
中長期仍以AI基礎建設及規格升級為核心，建議持續關注：

CPO、矽光子：AI叢集高速互連需求增加，光通訊有望持續提升滲透率。
液冷散熱、高壓直流供電：AI晶片功耗提升，帶動散熱及電力基礎建設需求。
先進製程、先進封裝： 受惠高階晶片需求，相關設備、材料及測試供應鏈持續受惠。
ASIC、高速傳輸：CSP自研晶片趨勢延續，帶動IC設計服務及高速互連商機。
ABF、被動元件、矽晶圓及成熟製程：留意產業庫存去化、報價調升、產能利用率回升及營收創高的轉機機會。


另外，S&P Global Ratings預估大型雲端業者AI基礎建設投資至2027年將超過1.3兆美元，長期需求值得關注，但也須留意資本支出與現金流失衡的風險。
五、操作策略：不追高、不殺低，選股重於選市

短線策略：目前大盤尚未止跌，應避免看到大漲就追、看到大跌就殺，尤其高估值、破線轉弱及基本面不佳的個股，暫時以避開為宜。
中線策略： 留意44,200點附近支撐，以及指數能否重新站回10日線、月線與季線，確認止跌訊號。
選股方向：優先鎖定具備實質訂單、獲利成長、低基期及產業趨勢明確的AI績優股，並觀察股價是否展現相對抗跌與籌碼穩定。
資金控管：採取分批布局、反彈汰弱留強、拉回低接優質股的方式，保留現金部位，嚴格執行停損及風險控管。


六、後市總結：短線利空淬鍊，長線仍須回歸基本面
整體而言，台股目前正處於國際利空衝擊與籌碼重新整理的階段，短線不宜過度樂觀，但也無須因為單日重挫，就否定AI長期成長趨勢。
真正值得把握的，不是指數每天漲跌多少，而是在市場信心低迷、資金重新洗牌的過程中，找出基本面沒有轉壞、產業趨勢持續向上，而且股價已經率先止穩的優質標的。

items.title: 〈光寶科法說〉800V Power Rack明年Q1出貨 2027資本支出高於197億元
items.title_en: Lite-On Technology Earnings Call: 800V Power Rack to Ship in Q1 Next Year, 2027 Capital Expenditure Exceeds NT$19.7 Billion
paras: 光寶科 (2301-TW) 今 (30) 日召開法說會，總經理邱森彬表示，800V HVDC Power Rack 已完成第一次送樣，11 月將第二次送樣，預計明年第一季開始出貨。為支應 AI 電源與機櫃級產品的成長，今年資本支出已從 180 億元上修到 197 億元；加上越南廣寧新廠的產線投資、美國德州廠營運，以及在全球擴大研發據點，明年資本支出還會再高於今年。公司預估明年 AI 營收占比可從今年的逾三成提高到四至五成。

光寶科指出，800V Power Rack 第一次送樣做產品認證，第二次送樣做系統整合認證，兩階段都通過後就會出貨。單一機櫃規格已從原本的 660kW 直接提高到 880kW，和運算機櫃大約是一比一的配置；另有客戶直接要 1.5MW。光寶科也透露，ASIC 客戶今年已導入 50V 低壓 Power Rack；NVIDIA 平台則會直接走 800V 高壓，下一代並希望 Power Rack 改採液冷。
對於市場傳出客戶機櫃遞延，光寶科表示，新產品的安規、零組件認證本來就需要時間，目前時程正在收斂，客戶沒有通知變更，公司仍然樂觀。產品認證、安規與系統驗證都照進度進行。不過光寶科也坦言，800V 屬於明年新平台、新資料中心的規格，實際放量要看客戶明年的落地進度。
新廠規畫部分，邱森彬表示，越南廣寧新廠的面積約為海防廠的四倍，約 100 多億元的產線投資是新增項目，不在今年 197 億元內，預計明年第一季開始動用，部分會延到後年。
邱森彬提到，伺服器客戶要求先把產能建好才會下單，所以公司必須先把設備與產線架好。加上高雄二期 12 月取得使用執照、美國德州麥金尼廠明年第二季營運，以及在美國等地擴大研發，明年資本支出「不會比今年少，一定是一年比一年多」。
面對市場缺工、缺人近況，光寶科說，亞洲與北美都缺人、缺設備、缺料、缺電，短期不容易解決，公司給出的 guidance 已經把這些瓶頸算進去。邱森彬認為，缺電是客戶最大的瓶頸，但 CSP 資本支出持續提高，相信客戶會想辦法解決，「唯一會影響的就是速度」。他以 BBU 為例，產品完成認證後，客戶拖了一年多才開始使用。
董事會今日決議把機構件事業分割給 100% 持股的子公司力能。邱森彬說，目的是讓團隊在人才、獎酬與決策上更有彈性，加快液冷事業發展；未來如果發展得好，也不排除申請上市。如果效果好，其他事業單位也可能比照分割，「AI 市場就是要快，慢了就沒機會」。
力能將負責 120kW 和 220kW 的 CDU，並結合光寶科入股的波蘭液冷廠 DCX 的設計與製造資源，雙方會把電源、CDU 與 Sidecar 整合成一個機櫃方案交給客戶，整合程度可做到 L5、L6。120kW CDU 已在第三季對企業客戶量產，第四季放量，明年的展望已經拿到。
光寶科今年資本支出從 180 億元上修到 197 億元。邱森彬表示，越南廣寧新廠約 100 多億元的產線投資是新增項目，不在 197 億元內，預計明年第一季開始動用。加上美國德州麥金尼廠明年第二季營運，以及在全球擴大研發據點，明年資本支出會比今年更高。
研發費用方面，光寶科目前研發費用率約 5%，目標先拉到 6%，之後還會往 7%、8% 走。邱森彬說，提高毛利的目的不是把錢放進口袋，而是投入研發形成正循環，長期毛利率目標要拉到至少 30%～35%。
其他事業方面，DC-DC 電源模組預估最快明年第三季開始貢獻營收。光電部門明年預估成長約一成，低軌衛星電源明年仍有機會翻倍以上成長。對於美國 337 調查，光寶科表示目前看起來沒有影響。
paras_en: Lite-On Technology (2301-TW) held its earnings conference today (the 30th). General Manager Chiu Sen‑bin said the 800V HVDC Power Rack has completed its first sample delivery, with a second sample to be sent in November, and shipments are expected to start in the first quarter of next year. To support growth in AI power supplies and rack‑level products, this year’s capital expenditure has been raised from NT$180 billion to NT$197 billion; together with production line investments at the new Guangning plant in Vietnam, operations at the Texas plant in the United States, and the expansion of R&D sites worldwide, next year’s capex will be higher than this year’s. The company forecasts AI revenue to rise from over 30% of sales this year to 40‑50% next year.

Lite-On explained that the first sample delivery of the 800V Power Rack is for product certification, while the second sample is for system integration certification. After both stages are passed, shipments will commence. The power rating of a single rack has been increased from the original 660 kW to 880 kW, roughly a 1:1 match with compute racks; some customers have even requested a 1.5 MW unit. Lite-On also disclosed that an ASIC customer has already adopted a 50 V low‑voltage Power Rack this year, while the NVIDIA platform will go straight to 800 V high‑voltage, and the next generation hopes to adopt liquid cooling for the Power Rack.

Regarding market rumors of delayed customer rack deployments, Lite-On said that safety and component certifications for the new product naturally take time, and the schedule is now converging. Customers have not indicated any changes, and the company remains optimistic. Product certification, safety approvals, and system verification are proceeding on schedule. However, Lite-On admitted that the 800V platform is a new specification for next‑year data centers, and actual volume will depend on customers’ rollout progress next year.

On the new plant plan, Chiu noted that the Guangning facility in Vietnam will be about four times the size of the Haiphong plant, with production line investments exceeding NT$100 billion. This is a new item not included in this year’s NT$197 billion capex and is expected to be drawn down starting in the first quarter of next year, with some spending pushed into the following year.

Chiu said server customers require the production capacity to be in place before placing orders, so the company must first build the equipment and production lines. With Kaohsiung Phase‑2 receiving its operating license in December, the McKinney plant in Texas slated to operate in Q2 next year, and expanded R&D sites in the United States and elsewhere, next year’s capital spending "won’t be less than this year – it will definitely be higher year over year."

Facing current labour, equipment, material and power shortages in Asia and North America, Lite-On said these constraints are short‑term and have already been factored into its guidance. Chiu believes power shortages are the biggest bottleneck for customers, but with CSP capex continuously rising, customers will find ways to address it, "the only impact will be on speed." He cited the BBU product as an example: after certification, the customer took more than a year before beginning use.

The board resolved today to spin off the mechanical components business to Li‑neng, a wholly‑owned subsidiary. Chiu said the aim is to give the team more flexibility in talent, compensation and decision‑making, accelerating the liquid‑cooling business; if it performs well, a public listing may be considered. If successful, other units could follow suit, "the AI market moves fast – slow and you lose the opportunity."

Li‑neng will handle the 120 kW and 220 kW CDUs, leveraging design and manufacturing resources from DCX, a Polish liquid‑cooling plant in which Lite-On holds a stake. Together they will integrate power supplies, CDUs and Sidecar into a single rack solution for customers, achieving integration levels of L5 or L6. The 120 kW CDU entered volume production for enterprise customers in Q3 and will scale up in Q4, with the outlook for next year already secured.

Lite-On’s capital expenditure this year has been revised from NT$180 billion to NT$197 billion. Chiu reiterated that the roughly NT$100 billion production line investment at the new Guangning plant in Vietnam is a new item outside the NT$197 billion figure and will start being drawn down in Q1 next year. Combined with the Texas McKinney plant’s operation in Q2 next year and the global expansion of R&D sites, next year’s capex will exceed this year’s.

Regarding R&D spending, Lite-On’s current R&D expense ratio is about 5%; the goal is to raise it to 6% first, then move toward 7%–8%. Chiu said the purpose of improving gross margin is not to pocket money but to invest in R&D to create a virtuous cycle, with a long‑term gross‑margin target of at least 30%–35%.

In other businesses, DC‑DC power‑module revenue is expected to start contributing in Q3 next year. The optoelectronics segment is projected to grow about 10% next year, and low‑earth‑orbit satellite power is expected to more than double. Regarding the U.S. Section 337 investigation, Lite-On said it currently sees no impact.

items.title_en: Lite-On Technology Q3 EPS Hits Record High of NT$3.27; Cloud Power Drives Moderate Seasonal Revenue Growth in Q4
paras: 電源供應廠光寶科(2301-TW)今(30)日召開法說會並公布第三季財報，第三季稅後純益 74.3 億元，季增 4.4%，年增 59.9%，每股純益 3.27 元；展望第四季，光寶科表示，全公司第四季營收預估季增溫和，年增率和第三季相近。
光寶科第三季營收 574 億元，季增 8.9%，年增 27.9%；毛利率 25.9%，季減 1.3 個百分點，年增 0.9 個百分點；營業利益 86.6 億元，季增 5.5%，年增 84.8%；營益率 15.1%，季減 0.5 個百分點，年增 4.7 個百分點。稅後純益 74.3 億元，季增 4.4%，年增 59.9%，每股純益 3.27 元。
光寶科前三季累計營收 1,535.1 億元，年增 26.1%；毛利率 25.2%，年增 1.9 個百分點；營業利益 209.6 億元，年增 73.4%；營益率 13.7%，年增 3.8 個百分點；稅後純益 183.2 億元，年增 62.8%，每股純益 8.08 元。
光寶科指出，第三季毛利率 25.9%、營益率 15.1%，都優於上半年的 24.7% 與 12.8%。毛利率雖然比第二季下滑，但總經理邱森彬說明，第二季因出貨遞延，毛利率本來就偏高，第三季並沒有一次性挹注。公司建議以半年平均來看獲利表現。
展望第四季，光寶科預估雲端電源仍有季增和年增，不過 PC 與消費性產品比較辛苦，全公司第四季營收預估季增溫和，年增率和第三季相近；毛利率則維持第三季水準。
資產負債表方面，第三季存貨季增 110 億元，短期借款季增 105 億元。公司說明，這是針對 PCB、高壓電容、半導體等關鍵零組件做的策略性備料，也是因應客戶依 未來發展要求的安全庫存。
產品營收占比部分，從雲端物聯網部門營收 338 億元，年增 57%，營收占比 59%，營業利益 71 億元，年增超過一倍。光電部門營收 81 億元，年增 17%，受惠工控與新能源應用。資訊及消費性電子部門營收 155 億元，年減 6%，營業利益 16 億元，年減 3%。
光寶科總經理邱森彬表示，雲端部門部門裡同時有企業級備援電源和 AI 伺服器電源。企業級產品年增約 30% 多，AI 伺服器電源成長八成以上，兩者合計大約成長七成。光寶科也說，雲端電源在第三季已占全公司營收約 52%，全年成長超過七成的目標不變。
資訊部門受到 PC 與消費性產品拖累，市場預估下半年 PC 衰退約兩成，衰退幅度比公司原本預期的大。光寶科靠低軌衛星電源出貨年增近一倍，抵銷了部分衰退。公司透露，低軌衛星電源約占資訊部門營收 10%，光寶科是美系兩大低軌衛星客戶的主要供應商。
paras_en: Lite-On Technology (2301-TW) held its earnings conference today (30th) and released its third‑quarter financial results, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$7.43 billion, up 4.4% sequentially and 59.9% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$3.27. Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, the company said it expects a modest sequential increase in group revenue, with an annual growth rate similar to that of the third quarter.

In Q3, Lite-On posted revenue of NT$57.4 billion, up 8.9% sequentially and 27.9% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 25.9%, down 1.3 percentage points sequentially but up 0.9 points year‑over‑year. Operating profit reached NT$8.66 billion, up 5.5% sequentially and 84.8% year‑over‑year, yielding an operating margin of 15.1%, down 0.5 points sequentially and up 4.7 points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$7.43 billion, up 4.4% sequentially and 59.9% year‑over‑year, translating to earnings per share of NT$3.27.

For the first three quarters, Lite-On’s cumulative revenue was NT$153.51 billion, a 26.1% year‑over‑year increase; gross margin stood at 25.2%, up 1.9 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating profit was NT$20.96 billion, up 73.4% year‑over‑year, with an operating margin of 13.7%, up 3.8 points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax totaled NT$18.32 billion, a 62.8% year‑over‑year rise, and earnings per share were NT$8.08.

Lite-On noted that the Q3 gross margin of 25.9% and operating margin of 15.1% both exceeded the first‑half figures of 24.7% and 12.8%. Although the gross margin slipped from Q2, General Manager Chiu Sen‑bin explained that Q2 margins were unusually high due to delayed shipments, and Q3 did not receive a one‑off boost. The company recommends evaluating profitability on a six‑month average basis.

Looking ahead to Q4, Lite-On expects cloud‑power sales to continue growing both sequentially and annually, while the PC and consumer‑electronics segments face tougher conditions. Group revenue for the quarter is projected to rise modestly sequentially, with an annual growth rate similar to Q3’s, and gross margin is expected to stay at the Q3 level.

On the balance sheet, Q3 inventory rose by NT$11 billion sequentially and short‑term borrowings increased by NT$10.5 billion. The company said these reflect strategic stocking of key components such as PCBs, high‑voltage capacitors and semiconductors, as well as safety stock to meet customers’ future development requirements.

In terms of product revenue mix, the cloud‑IoT segment generated NT$33.8 billion, up 57% year‑over‑year and accounting for 59% of total revenue, with operating profit of NT$7.1 billion, more than double the prior year. The optoelectronics segment posted NT$8.1 billion in revenue, up 17% year‑over‑year, benefiting from industrial control and new‑energy applications. The information and consumer‑electronics segment recorded NT$15.5 billion in revenue, down 6% year‑over‑year, with operating profit of NT$1.6 billion, down 3% year‑over‑year.

General Manager Chiu Sen‑bin said the cloud segment includes both enterprise‑grade backup power supplies and AI server power supplies. Enterprise products grew roughly 30% year‑over‑year, while AI server power supplies surged by more than 80%, together delivering about a 70% overall increase. Lite-On also noted that cloud power accounted for roughly 52% of total company revenue in Q3, and the target of over 70% annual growth remains unchanged.

The information segment was weighed down by the PC and consumer‑electronics slowdown, with market forecasts indicating a roughly 20% decline in PC shipments in the second half, a larger drop than the company had anticipated. Lite-On offset part of the decline with low‑Earth‑orbit satellite power shipments that nearly doubled year‑over‑year. The company disclosed that low‑Earth‑orbit satellite power makes up about 10% of the information segment’s revenue, and Lite-On is a major supplier to two leading U.S. LEO satellite customers.

items.title_en: Foreign investors slash Taiwan stocks by NT$112.4 billion in a day, marking the seventh‑largest net sell‑off ever, and turn to defensive industrial stocks
paras: 台北股市今(30)日大盤開低震盪，尾盤集中市場守住45000點大關，以45211.83點作收，較昨日下跌1156.5點，市場成交值8777.3億元。集中市場三大法人合計賣超1398.44億元，其中外資下重手賣超1124.67億元，創下史上第七大賣超紀錄，同時，外資在期貨市場並加空1780口空單。
外資今天在集中市場酌量買超的個股多屬傳產、航運及電信族群龍頭股，包括台泥(1101-TW)、中華電(2412-TW)、長榮(2603-TW)、寶成(9904-TW)、統一(1216-TW)。
今天在現貨市場中，外資賣超1124.67億元，投信買超239.93億元，自營商合計賣超513.7億元，三大法人合計賣超1398.44億元，在期貨市場，外資30日交易口數淨額爲空單1780口，未平倉口數爲空單94241口。
新台幣兌美元匯率今天以32.478元作收、升值1.4分，台北外匯市場成交金額24.4億美元。
今天集中市場外資買超較多的個股爲，陽明、台泥、臺企銀、中華電、合庫金、長榮、寶成、統一、華航、彰銀；今天集中市場外資賣超較多的個股爲，友達、力積電、國巨*、南亞、仁寶、台新新光金、宏碁、緯創、群創。
今天集中市場投信買超較多的個股爲，台新新光金、中信金、佳世達、日月光投控、玉山金、第一金、國泰金、永豐金、元大金、南亞；今天集中市場投信賣超較多的個股爲，聯電、華航、遠東新、台泥、友達、統一、昇陽半導體、致伸、長興、台達電。
今天集中市場自營商買超較多的個股爲，台新新光金、華南金、凱基金、浪凡、兆豐金、中信金、玉山金、永豐金、元大金、統一；今天集中市場自營商賣超較多的個股爲，友達、群創。
資深證券、期貨分析師張陳浩指出，台股今天以45211.83點作收，下跌1156.5點，大盤最大敗筆在於大盤跌破半年線，大盤整理的時間將拉長，主要在谷歌、英特爾等重量級美股提出的展望引發市場對科技類股現金流及投資回收的重大疑慮，同時，台股處於高檔區，在此一情境之下，也引發多殺多的格局，但並未顯示台股大幅走空。
paras_en: The Taipei stock market opened lower and traded sideways today (30th), with the main board holding above the 45,000‑point threshold, closing at 45,211.83 points, down 1,156.5 points from yesterday. Market turnover was NT$8777.3 billion. The three major institutional investors in the main board net sold NT$1398.44 billion, of which foreign investors sold a heavy NT$1124.67 billion, the seventh‑largest net sell‑off on record. At the same time, foreign investors added 1,780 short contracts in the futures market.

Today, the stocks that foreign investors modestly net bought in the main board were mainly leaders in the traditional industry, shipping and telecom sectors, including Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW), Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW), Evergreen Marine (2603‑TW), Pou Chen (9904‑TW) and Uni‑President (1216‑TW).

In the spot market today, foreign investors sold NT$1124.67 billion, investment trusts bought NT$239.93 billion, proprietary traders sold NT$513.7 billion, for a combined net sell of NT$1398.44 billion among the three major institutions. In the futures market, foreign investors had a net short position of 1,780 contracts on the 30th, with open interest of 94,241 short contracts.
The New Taiwan dollar closed at NT$32.478 per US dollar, appreciating 0.014, and the Taipei foreign‑exchange market saw a transaction volume of US$2.44 billion.

In the main board, the stocks with the largest foreign‑investor net purchases were Yang Ming, Taiwan Cement, Taichung Commercial Bank, Chunghwa Telecom, Heku Financial, Evergreen Marine, Pou Chen, Uni‑President, China Airlines, and Chang Hwa Bank. The stocks with the largest foreign‑investor net sales were AU Optronics, Powerchip, Yageo*, Nanya, Compal, Taishin Shin Kong Financial, Acer, Wistron, and Innolux.

Among investment trusts, the top net‑buy stocks in the main board were Taishin Shin Kong Financial, CTBC Financial, Qisda, ASE Technology Holding, E.SUN Financial, First Financial, Cathay Financial, Yongfeng Financial, Yuanta Financial, and Nanya. The top net‑sell stocks were United Microelectronics, China Airlines, Far Eastern New Century, Taiwan Cement, AU Optronics, Uni‑President, Sunplus Technology, ChipMOS, Chang Hsing, and Delta Electronics.

Among proprietary traders, the top net‑buy stocks in the main board were Taishin Shin Kong Financial, Hua Nan Financial, KGI Fund, Langfan, Mega Financial, CTBC Financial, E.SUN Financial, Yongfeng Financial, Yuanta Financial, and Uni‑President. The top net‑sell stocks were AU Optronics and Innolux.

Senior securities and futures analyst Zhang Chen‑hao noted that the Taiwan market closed at 45,211.83 points, down 1,156.5 points. The biggest flaw was the index falling below its six‑month moving average, which will likely lengthen the consolidation period. The outlooks from heavyweight U.S. stocks such as Google and Intel raised major concerns about cash flow and investment returns for tech stocks, and with the Taiwan market in a high‑level zone, this scenario sparked a “sell‑more‑sell‑more” pattern, though it did not indicate a sharp short‑term decline.

items.title: 〈鴻海科技日〉發表3款全新電動車參考設計 擴大B2B產品組合
items.title_en: Foxconn Technology Day Unveils Three New Electric Vehicle Reference Designs, Expanding B2B Product Portfolio
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(30)日於科技日發表3款全新參考設計電動車，分別為休旅車MODEL A+、MODEL K+及小型貨卡MODEL K，鎖定B級SUV、年輕族群及輕型商用車等市場，持續展現為汽車客戶提供委託設計製造服務(CDMS)的實力，進一步擴大B2B電動車產品組合。
此次發表的3款車型各有不同定位。其中，MODEL A+延續MODEL A的設計理念，瞄準成長快速的B級SUV市場，進一步擴大鴻海B2B產品組合。車款融合奢華風格與越野性能，搭載輪內馬達技術，並提供電子電氣架構(EEA)選配，鎖定有意切入高附加價值電動車市場的企業客戶。
MODEL K+則主打年輕族群及利基市場，以日本懷舊元素結合新世代City Pop風格，打造兼具個性與親民價格的生活風格休旅車。車款搭載輪內馬達技術，外觀、內裝、續航里程及電子電氣架構均可依客戶需求客製化，協助車廠以具競爭力的價格，開發具品牌特色的電動車。
至於MODEL K，則是鴻海切入日本K-Car輕型貨卡級距的新設計，外觀承襲大型巴士MODEL T的設計語彙，鎖定配送、行動商業及防災等商用需求。車體結構強調實用性，可搭配不同車體改裝及服務，應用於最後一哩物流、移動商鋪及行動供電站等場景，並藉由降低能源使用及維護成本，減少總持有成本(TCO)。
除了3款新車，鴻海此次也展示電動移動生態系的研發成果，涵蓋材料、電芯、電池模組、電池管理系統(BMS)，以及電子電氣架構與電動二輪車、三輪車動力系統。此外，現場也展出右駕版MODEL B，呈現鴻海與車廠合作的CDMS成果。
鴻海自6年前推出首款參考車型以來，參考設計電動車陣容已累計達12款。除此次發表的3款新車外，既有車型還包括大型巴士MODEL T、休旅車MODEL C、豪華轎車MODEL E、跨界休旅車MODEL B、貨卡MODEL V、廂型貨車MODEL N、多功能休旅車MODEL D、中型巴士MODEL U，以及模組化B級車MODEL A。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317-TW) today (30th) announced three brand‑new reference‑design electric vehicles at its Technology Day: the SUV MODEL A+, the MODEL K+, and the compact cargo van MODEL K. Targeting the B‑segment SUV market, younger consumers and light‑commercial vehicles, the launch showcases Foxconn’s capability to provide contract design‑manufacturing services (CDMS) for automotive clients and further broadens its B2B EV product lineup.

The three models each serve a distinct market niche. MODEL A+ carries forward the design philosophy of the original MODEL A and aims at the fast‑growing B‑segment SUV segment, further expanding Foxconn’s B2B offerings. The vehicle blends a luxury aesthetic with off‑road capability, features in‑wheel motor technology and offers an optional electronic‑electrical architecture (EEA), appealing to corporate customers looking to enter the high‑value‑add EV market.

MODEL K+ is aimed at younger buyers and niche markets, combining nostalgic Japanese elements with a new‑generation City‑Pop style to create a lifestyle‑oriented SUV that is both distinctive and affordable. It uses in‑wheel motors, and its exterior, interior, range and EEA can be customized to customer specifications, helping automakers develop brand‑centric EVs at competitive prices.

MODEL K represents Foxconn’s entry into Japan’s K‑Car light‑cargo‑van segment, borrowing the design language of the large‑bus MODEL T. It targets delivery, mobile business and disaster‑relief applications. The vehicle’s structure emphasizes practicality and can be fitted with various body‑work modifications and services for last‑mile logistics, mobile shops and mobile power‑station scenarios, reducing energy use, maintenance expenses and overall total cost of ownership (TCO).

In addition to the three new models, Foxconn also displayed its electric‑mobility ecosystem R&D results, covering materials, cells, battery modules, battery‑management systems (BMS), as well as electronic‑electrical architectures and power‑train systems for electric two‑ and three‑wheelers. A right‑hand‑drive version of MODEL B was also shown, illustrating Foxconn’s CDMS collaborations with vehicle manufacturers.

Since launching its first reference model six years ago, Foxconn’s portfolio of reference‑design EVs has grown to twelve models. Beyond the three newly announced vehicles, the existing lineup includes the large bus MODEL T, SUV MODEL C, luxury sedan MODEL E, crossover SUV MODEL B, cargo van MODEL V, box truck MODEL N, multi‑purpose SUV MODEL D, mid‑size bus MODEL U, and the modular B‑segment vehicle MODEL A.

items.title: 台股震盪整理 考驗主動式ETF策略
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Consolidates, Testing Active ETF Strategies
paras: 台股近期遭遇明顯修正，外資調節、科技股震盪與市場避險情緒升溫，使投資人對第四季行情轉趨謹慎。然而，股價下跌不代表基本面同步轉弱。台灣外銷訂單持續成長，製造業用電警戒燈號連續18個月亮紅燈，反映產業活動仍具一定動能；政府基金釋出1,550億元代操資金，也為後續市場資金動向增添觀察重點。短線行情或許風雨飄搖，但投資判斷仍須回到企業獲利與估值，而非單看指數漲跌。

面對震盪，除了觀察技術面，更應檢視個股籌碼。台股融資餘額仍在6,400多億元的高檔，卻不能單憑融資水位就認定市場即將出現全面性斷頭。真正需要警戒的是融資使用率偏高、融資維持率偏低的個股，一旦股價持續下跌，容易引發追繳與被迫賣出；反之，若企業獲利仍有成長動能，且融資維持率相對穩健，行情回穩時也可能出現反彈機會。對偏好穩健的投資人而言，瑞昱、達發、健策及華新科等個股，可進一步從估值、獲利與籌碼結構重新檢視。市場恐慌時，關鍵不是急著抄底，而是辨識風險與機會。
接下來，聯準會利率決策與美國科技巨頭財報，將是影響市場信心的重要變數。Google、微軟、亞馬遜等企業的資本支出展望，將牽動全球AI供應鏈的投資預期。從產業趨勢來看，AI算力建置仍是中長期主軸，記憶體受惠供需變化與長約需求，ABF載板、PCB、玻纖布及銅箔基板則有產品升級、供給緊張與價格調整等題材；電力、散熱、先進封裝及半導體設備，也持續受惠資料中心與AI基礎建設的擴張。
不過，產業成長不代表股價只漲不跌。當資金集中追逐特定題材，估值偏高、持股過度擁擠的族群，仍可能在市場風險偏好下降時遭到集中調節。聯發科AI ASIC業務雖有部分專案時程調整的雜音，長期成長潛力仍值得觀察；記憶體與高階載板也須持續追蹤供需、訂單及價格變化。第四季較可能呈現多個產業輪動，而非單一族群全面領漲。投資人除了看成長故事，更應確認獲利能否兌現，並衡量股價是否已提前反映未來利多。

在市場震盪、個股表現分歧的環境下，主動式ETF的績效差異，也反映不同投資組合在修正期間的承受能力。以6月24日至10月27日為比較區間，其中規模高達2800多億的主動統一台股增長 (00981A)為 - 11.02%，主動統一升級(00403A)則為 -10.69%，主動中信台灣收益(00406A)為 -9.66%，而主動凱基台灣(00407A)報酬率則為 -7.09%。就這四檔產品的統計結果而言，00407A跌幅相對較小，期間表現優於其餘三檔比較標的。
主動式ETF的績效，會受到經理人選股、持股權重、產業配置與進出場時點影響；市場風格改變時，原本有利的配置也可能轉為壓力。投資人評估產品時，除了比較階段報酬，也應留意最大回檔、波動程度、持股集中度、費用及操作策略。尤其在市場快速修正時，短期跌幅較小固然值得注意，但是否能在不同行情中持續維持風險與報酬的平衡，仍需要更長期間的績效資料驗證。
除了選股與持股配置，配息政策也是評估ETF時不可忽略的一環。由於00407A採取不配息策略，與定期配息型ETF的資金運用方式不同。配息型產品能提供投資人可運用的現金流，但配息並不等於額外創造報酬；不配息產品則不透過現金配發將收益交到投資人手中，投資人更應關注基金淨值變化及整體資產累積效果。兩種策略各有適用情境，不能僅憑配息與否判斷優劣。

paras_en: The Taiwan stock market has recently undergone a noticeable correction, with foreign investors adjusting, tech stocks fluctuating, and market hedging sentiment intensifying, leading investors to become more cautious about the fourth‑quarter outlook. However, falling prices do not mean fundamentals are weakening in tandem. Taiwan’s export orders continue to grow, and the manufacturing sector’s electricity warning light has stayed red for 18 consecutive months, indicating that industrial activity still retains momentum; the government fund has released NT$155 billion of discretionary capital, adding a focal point for future market‑fund flow observations. Short‑term moves may be turbulent, but investment judgments should return to corporate earnings and valuations rather than merely index swings.

In the face of volatility, beyond technical analysis one should examine individual stock fundamentals. Taiwan’s margin financing balance remains high at over NT$640 billion, yet a high financing level alone does not signal an imminent market-wide crash. The real warning lies with stocks that have a high financing usage rate and low maintenance margin; if their prices keep falling, margin calls and forced sales can erupt. Conversely, if a company’s earnings still have growth momentum and its maintenance margin remains solid, a rebound may emerge when the market steadies. For investors who favor stability, stocks such as Realtek, Dafa, Jencet and Huaxin Technology can be re‑evaluated on valuation, profitability and capital structure. In times of market panic, the key is not to rush to bottom‑fish but to identify risk and opportunity.

Looking ahead, the Federal Reserve’s rate decisions and earnings reports from U.S. tech giants will be pivotal for market confidence. Outlooks for capital expenditures from Google, Microsoft, Amazon and others will shape global AI supply‑chain investment expectations. From an industry perspective, AI compute power remains a mid‑to‑long‑term focus; memory chips benefit from supply‑demand shifts and long‑term contracts, while ABF substrates, PCBs, glass‑fiber cloth and copper‑foil substrates see themes of product upgrades, tight supply and price adjustments. Power, cooling, advanced packaging and semiconductor equipment also continue to profit from data‑center and AI infrastructure expansion.

Nevertheless, industry growth does not guarantee that stock prices only rise. When capital chases specific themes, over‑valued and overly crowded stocks can be sharply corrected as risk appetite wanes. MediaTek’s AI ASIC business, despite some project‑timeline noise, still holds long‑term growth potential; memory and high‑end substrates also require ongoing monitoring of supply‑demand, orders and price changes. The fourth quarter is likely to feature multiple sector rotations rather than a single group leading the rally. Investors should not only follow growth narratives but also verify whether earnings can be realized and assess whether prices have already priced in future upside.

In a volatile market with divergent stock performances, the differing returns of active ETFs also reflect how various portfolios weather corrections. Over the period from June 24 to October 27, the large‑cap active Unified Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A) posted a –11.02% return, the active Unified Upgrade ETF (00403A) –10.69%, the active CTBC Taiwan Yield ETF (00406A) –9.66%, while the active KGI Taiwan ETF (00407A) returned –7.09%. Among these four, 00407A experienced the smallest decline and outperformed the other three during the interval.

Active‑ETF performance is shaped by the manager’s stock‑picking, weightings, sector allocation and timing of trades; when market styles shift, a previously advantageous allocation can become a liability. When evaluating a product, investors should look beyond period returns to maximum drawdown, volatility, concentration, fees and the underlying strategy. Especially in rapid corrections, a modest short‑term drop is noteworthy, but whether the fund can sustain a risk‑return balance across different market regimes requires longer‑term performance evidence.

Beyond stock selection and weighting, dividend policy is another essential factor in ETF assessment. Because 00407A follows a non‑dividend approach, its cash‑flow dynamics differ from regularly distributing ETFs. Dividend‑paying products provide investors with usable cash flow, yet dividends do not create extra return; non‑dividend funds retain earnings within the fund, so investors should focus on NAV changes and overall asset accumulation. Both strategies suit different scenarios and should not be judged solely on the presence or absence of payouts.

paras: 一、盤勢結構：利空衝擊加劇，指數重挫逾千點

台股今日呈現「開低震盪走低」格局，終場大跌 1,156點，收在45,211點，成交值約8,777億元，盤中最低下探44,726點，跌幅一度超過1,600點，顯示市場避險情緒明顯升高。
主要受到美國科技股重挫、AI資本支出效益疑慮升溫影響，加上Alphabet財報不如預期、Marvell股價大跌，市場重新檢視AI投資回收期與企業獲利能力，導致AI供應鏈及電子權值股遭遇沉重賣壓。
此外，中東地緣政治風險與能源價格的不確定性仍在，進一步壓抑投資人追價意願。短線而言，市場信心尚未恢復，利空反覆測試底部的震盪整理，仍是合理的發展。


二、技術面：重要均線失守，44,200點附近成為觀察重點

指數已跌破10日線、月線及季線，短期均線呈現下彎壓力，技術結構明顯轉弱，短線仍須提防賣壓持續釋放。
盤中一度跌破半年線，但終場重新站回45,000點及半年線附近，代表下檔仍有部分承接力量。
下檔先觀察8月25日止跌區約44,210點附近，以及7月31日止跌長紅K棒約41,610～43,214點區間。若能逐步止穩，才有機會形成新的築底結構。
後續須觀察成交量是否降溫、指數能否重新站回10日線及月線，作為市場信心與反彈力道恢復的重要依據。


三、基本面：AI長線需求未變，台灣經濟仍具成長動能

台股短線受到國際科技股修正拖累，但台灣出口與AI產業基本面仍然強勁。經濟部公布9月外銷訂單達 1,142.1億美元，年增62.4％，連續兩個月突破千億美元，前9月累計8,192億美元，已提前超越去年全年紀錄。
經濟成長方面，央行最新預估2026年GDP成長率達11.48％，主計總處預估11.05％，顯示台灣經濟成長動能仍相當強勁。
AI並非需求消失，而是市場開始要求企業證明資本支出的獲利回收能力。Alphabet第三季雲端營收年增103％，但自由現金流轉負，正反映AI產業從高速擴張進入獲利驗證階段。
因此，短線評價修正不等於產業趨勢反轉，後續應更加重視訂單能見度、毛利率、現金流及實際獲利成長。


四、產業布局：掌握AI五大核心主軸與低基期復甦族群
中長期仍以AI基礎建設及規格升級為核心，建議持續關注：

CPO、矽光子：AI叢集高速互連需求增加，光通訊有望持續提升滲透率。
液冷散熱、高壓直流供電：AI晶片功耗提升，帶動散熱及電力基礎建設需求。
先進製程、先進封裝： 受惠高階晶片需求，相關設備、材料及測試供應鏈持續受惠。
ASIC、高速傳輸：CSP自研晶片趨勢延續，帶動IC設計服務及高速互連商機。
ABF、被動元件、矽晶圓及成熟製程：留意產業庫存去化、報價調升、產能利用率回升及營收創高的轉機機會。


另外，S&P Global Ratings預估大型雲端業者AI基礎建設投資至2027年將超過1.3兆美元，長期需求值得關注，但也須留意資本支出與現金流失衡的風險。
五、操作策略：不追高、不殺低，選股重於選市

短線策略：目前大盤尚未止跌，應避免看到大漲就追、看到大跌就殺，尤其高估值、破線轉弱及基本面不佳的個股，暫時以避開為宜。
中線策略： 留意44,200點附近支撐，以及指數能否重新站回10日線、月線與季線，確認止跌訊號。
選股方向：優先鎖定具備實質訂單、獲利成長、低基期及產業趨勢明確的AI績優股，並觀察股價是否展現相對抗跌與籌碼穩定。
資金控管：採取分批布局、反彈汰弱留強、拉回低接優質股的方式，保留現金部位，嚴格執行停損及風險控管。


六、後市總結：短線利空淬鍊，長線仍須回歸基本面
整體而言，台股目前正處於國際利空衝擊與籌碼重新整理的階段，短線不宜過度樂觀，但也無須因為單日重挫，就否定AI長期成長趨勢。
真正值得把握的，不是指數每天漲跌多少，而是在市場信心低迷、資金重新洗牌的過程中，找出基本面沒有轉壞、產業趨勢持續向上，而且股價已經率先止穩的優質標的。
操作上堅守「選股重於選市、低接不追高」，等待利空逐步鈍化、技術面重新轉強，才是面對這一波震盪行情較穩健的布局方式。

2. The Taiwan stock market today showed a "low open, shaky decline" pattern, ending the session down 1,156 points at 45,211 points, with a turnover of about NT$877.7 billion. The intraday low dipped to 44,726 points, a drop of more than 1,600 points at one point, indicating a clear rise in market hedging sentiment. The decline was mainly driven by a sharp fall in U.S. tech stocks and growing doubts about the profitability of AI capital expenditures, compounded by Alphabet’s earnings missing expectations and a steep drop in Marvell’s share price. Investors re‑examined AI investment payback periods and corporate profitability, leading to heavy selling pressure on AI supply‑chain and electronics‑weight stocks. In addition, Middle‑East geopolitical risks and uncertainty over energy prices continued to suppress investors’ willingness to chase prices. In the short term, market confidence has not yet recovered, and repeated negative tests of the bottom with sideways consolidation remain a reasonable development.
3. Technical View: Key moving averages broken, the area around 44,200 points becomes the focus of observation.

4. The index has fallen below the 10‑day, monthly and quarterly moving averages, with short‑term averages showing a downward curvature and the technical structure clearly weakening. Short‑term traders still need to guard against continued selling pressure. The index briefly broke below the half‑year line during the session but closed back above 45,000 points and near the half‑year line, indicating some support at lower levels. The next lower area to watch is around 44,210 points, the stopping‑point zone as of August 25, and the long‑red‑candle zone from July 31 between roughly 41,610 and 43,214 points. If the index can gradually stabilize, there is a chance to form a new base structure. Subsequent observation should focus on whether trading volume cools and whether the index can retake the 10‑day and monthly lines, which are important gauges of market confidence and rebound strength.
5. Fundamentals: Long‑term AI demand remains unchanged, Taiwan’s economy still has growth momentum.

6. The Taiwan market’s short‑term weakness is due to the correction in international tech stocks, but Taiwan’s export figures and AI industry fundamentals remain strong. The Ministry of Economic Affairs reported September export orders of US$114.21 billion, up 62.4% year‑over‑year, marking the second consecutive month exceeding US$100 billion. Cumulative orders for the first nine months reached US$819.2 billion, already surpassing last year’s full‑year record. Regarding economic growth, the central bank now projects a 2026 GDP growth rate of 11.48%, while the Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics forecasts 11.05%, showing that Taiwan’s growth engine remains robust. AI demand has not vanished; the market now requires companies to prove the profitability of their capital spending. Alphabet’s cloud revenue grew 103% year‑over‑year in Q3, but free cash flow turned negative, reflecting the AI sector’s shift from rapid expansion to a profit‑validation phase. Therefore, short‑term valuation adjustments do not equal a reversal of the industry trend. Future focus should be on order visibility, margins, cash flow and actual profit growth.
7. Industry Positioning: Capture the five core AI pillars and low‑base‑period recovery groups.
8. In the medium to long term, AI infrastructure and specification upgrades remain central. It is recommended to continue monitoring:
9. CPO, silicon photonics: Growing demand for high‑speed interconnects in AI clusters, with optical communications expected to increase penetration.
10. Liquid‑cooling and high‑voltage DC power supply: Higher power consumption of AI chips drives demand for cooling and power infrastructure.
11. Advanced processes and advanced packaging: Benefiting from high‑end chip demand, related equipment, materials and test supply chains continue to gain.
12. ASICs and high‑speed transmission: Ongoing trend of CSP‑developed chips fuels IC design services and high‑speed interconnect opportunities.
13. ABF, passive components, silicon wafers and mature processes: Watch for inventory depletion, price hikes, capacity utilization recovery and revenue‑record opportunities.

14. Additionally, S&P Global Ratings forecasts that large cloud providers’ AI infrastructure investment will exceed US$1.3 trillion by 2027. Long‑term demand is worth watching, but the risk of mismatched capital expenditure and cash flow should also be considered.
15. 5. Trading Strategy: Do not chase highs or kill lows; stock selection outweighs market timing.

16. Short‑term strategy: The market has not yet stopped falling, so avoid buying on big rallies or selling on sharp drops, especially for high‑valuation stocks that have broken key lines and show weak fundamentals; it is better to stay out for now.
17. Medium‑term strategy: Watch the support around 44,200 points and whether the index can retake the 10‑day, monthly and quarterly lines to confirm a bottom‑testing signal.

20. Outlook Summary: Short‑term negatives are being forged, but the long‑term still needs to return to fundamentals.

22. What truly matters is not the daily index swing, but identifying high‑quality targets that have not seen their fundamentals deteriorate, whose industry trends remain upward, and whose prices have already begun to stabilize amid low market confidence and capital reallocation.

items.title: 【盤後贏指標】狂殺1156點！45K守得住嗎？贏指標「跌破12日」，反彈先看這條線！
items.title_en: After‑Hours Winning Indicator: Slashed 1,156 Points! Can the 45,000 Level Hold? Winning Indicator “Breaks Below 12‑Day”, Look at This Line for the Rebound!
paras:
一、大盤分析｜45K失而復得，但贏指標仍在示警



台股10月30日再度遭遇沉重賣壓！加權指數開盤46,139.79點，開盤即為全日最高，隨後一路走低，盤中最低下探44,726.26點，一度跌破45,000點整數關卡。儘管尾盤跌幅收斂，終場仍重挫1,156.50點，收在45,211.83點，跌幅2.49%。
對投資人來說，45K收復似乎帶來一點希望，但從《贏指標》的系統數據來看，現在還不能把行情解讀成止跌。
今日加權指數的贏指標數據：
贏指標：跌破12日
指標趨勢：偏弱勢
最值得注意的是，雖然收盤重新站回45K，但指數距離系統強弱關鍵仍有約1,770點的差距，代表市場反彈與趨勢轉強是兩件不同的事。
贏指標教學重點：看大盤不能只看今天漲跌，更要確認系統訊號是否改變。 當贏指標持續顯示「跌破」，即使盤中出現反彈，也應先以弱勢結構來觀察，而不是提前認定行情已經反轉。

二、技術結構｜不只跌破45K，三條均線也全部失守



從贏指標日K線觀察，今天的下跌不只是整數關卡失守，短、中期技術結構也同步承壓。
目前重要均線位置：
加權指數收在45,211.83點，已經低於上述三條均線。其中5日線位於46,150點附近，代表短線如果要修復走勢，首先需要觀察指數能否重新站回這個位置。
再看MACD指標，DIF為-339.01、DEA為-2.31，MACD柱狀值為-336.70，顯示短線動能仍然偏弱，尚未出現明確的動能翻轉訊號。
若要進一步確認市場強弱改善，仍須持續追蹤贏指標是否脫離跌破狀態，以及強弱關鍵如何變化。

三、資金流向｜指數跌千點，資金卻沒有完全停止流動

今天台股跌幅達2.49%，但觀察各產業表現，會發現一個有趣的現象：
當主要權值族群承壓，部分傳統產業反而呈現逆勢上漲。
根據10月30日產業漲幅排行：
貿易百貨業：+0.67%
當大盤大幅下跌，這些產業仍能維持上漲，代表市場內部的強弱表現出現明顯分歧。
進一步切換至《贏指標》APP的「產業資金流－淨流入」，畫面顯示：
航運業的淨流入金額為72.37億元，資訊服務業為23.18億元，食品工業為10.73億元，油電燃氣業則為9.71億元。
這裡有一個值得學習的重點：
產業漲幅與資金流向是不同的觀察面向，不能只看其中一項。
例如航運業今天位居產業漲幅第一，同時也出現在資金淨流入畫面，可以作為進一步研究資金輪動的線索。
但單日淨流入不能直接推論後續會持續上漲，仍要觀察接下來幾個交易日的資金是否延續，以及產業內是否有更多股票同步轉強。
對投資人來說，真正值得追蹤的並不是哪個產業今天漲最多，而是當市場出現震盪時，資金是否逐漸形成新的集中方向。

四、贏指標策略觀察｜大盤弱勢，如何利用系統尋找相對強勢？

這次我們換個角度，不直接從熱門個股開始，而是先從產業表現出發，再回到贏指標的選股策略驗證。
打開《贏指標》的「指標精選－偏強機會股」，可以發現即使大盤處於跌破12日狀態，部分個股仍然維持突破訊號。
① 航運資金活躍，個股訊號是否同步？
航運業今天上漲1.93%，在資金流向畫面也出現72.37億元淨流入。
進一步觀察偏強機會股清單，長榮（2603）今日上漲4.02%，贏指標顯示「突破13日」。
這個案例讓我們看到，當產業表現相對強勢，同時個股也具有突破訊號，就可以進一步研究兩者是否形成一致的強勢結構。
但要注意，突破13日是目前的系統狀態，不代表未來13天還會持續上漲。
② 食品逆勢上漲，防禦性資金值得觀察
食品工業今天上漲0.89%，資金流向畫面顯示淨流入10.73億元。
偏強機會股中的味全（1201），今日上漲9.72%，贏指標顯示「突破13日」。
當市場大跌時，部分食品類股仍能逆勢表現，值得進一步觀察是否屬於資金短期轉移的現象。
不過，單日強勢不代表防禦性資金已經建立長期趨勢，仍需透過後續資金流及個股強弱關鍵加以追蹤。
③ 不是所有強勢股，都有產業同步支持
再看冠西電（2466），今日上漲9.94%，贏指標顯示「突破8日」；大世科（8099）上漲8.78%，顯示「突破12日」。
這些股票出現在偏強機會股清單中，但不能因為個股上漲，就直接認定其所屬產業資金同步轉強。
這正是《贏指標》策略教學中重要的一環：
個股突破訊號、產業強弱與產業資金流向，需要分開確認，再進行交叉比對。
實際操作APP時，可以先確認大盤贏指標狀態，再觀察產業漲幅與資金流，最後使用偏強機會股策略尋找符合系統條件的股票。
若個股有突破訊號，卻缺乏產業資金支持，就需要額外追蹤訊號延續性；若產業、資金與個股訊號同步，則可以列入後續觀察名單，但不代表立即形成買進條件。
這樣的使用方式，才能讓選股從單純追逐漲幅，轉變為有條件、有紀律的系統化觀察。

五、總結｜45K能不能守住？先讓贏指標告訴你市場有沒有改善

今天台股收盤重新站回45K，但從贏指標來看，系統仍顯示「跌破12日」，指標趨勢維持偏弱勢。
接下來值得觀察的，不只是45,000點能否守住，而是市場能否逐步修復弱勢結構。
短線先觀察今日低點44,726.26點及45K整數關卡，反彈則留意5日線46,150.68點與60日線46,540.70點。
至於系統強弱是否真正改善，仍要回到贏指標的跌破訊號與46,981.50點強弱關鍵追蹤。
另一方面，航運、食品等產業出現相對強勢，也提醒投資人：大盤弱勢時，不代表所有資金都朝同一個方向移動。
真正重要的不是猜測哪一天會反彈，而是學會利用贏指標，辨識目前的市場風險、資金變化與個股強弱。
想要進一步討論贏指標內容嗎？
